title: 3dLocalstat
description: This program computes statistics at each voxel, based on a local neighborhood of that voxel

nbhd.description: The region around each voxel that will be extracted for the statistics calculation
nbhd.title: Neighborhood definition

stat.description: Compute the specified statistic on the values extracted from the neighborhood
stat.title: Statistic

mask.description: Read in dataset 'mset' and use the nonzero voxels therein as a mask
mask.title: Mask dataset

automask.description: Compute the mask as in program 3dAutomask (mutually exclusive with -mask)
automask.title: Automask

use_nonmask.description: Compute local statistics from all voxels in the neighborhood that are in the mask, even if the central voxel is not in the mask
use_nonmask.title: Use nonmask

prefix.description: Use the given string as the prefix for the output dataset
prefix.title: Prefix

datum.description: Coerce the output data to be stored as the given type (byte, short, float)
datum.title: Datum type

label_ext.description: Append given label to each sub-brick label
label_ext.title: Label extension

reduce_grid.description: Compute output on a grid that is reduced by the given factor in X, Y, and Z directions of the input dataset
reduce_grid.title: Reduce grid

reduce_restore_grid.description: Resample the output back to input grid after reducing the grid
reduce_restore_grid.title: Reduce restore grid

reduce_max_vox.description: Automatically set Rx Ry Rz so that the computation grid is at a resolution of nbhd/MAX_VOX voxels
reduce_max_vox.title: Reduce max voxels

grid_rmode.description: Interpolant to use when resampling the output with reduce_restore_grid option
grid_rmode.title: Grid resample mode

quiet.description: Stop the highly informative progress reports
quiet.title: Quiet mode

proceed_small_N.description: Do not crash if neighborhood is too small for certain estimates
proceed_small_N.title: Proceed with small neighborhood

fillvalue.description: Value used for filled statistic, default=1
fillvalue.title: Fill value

unfillvalue.description: Value used for unfilled statistic, default=1
unfillvalue.title: Unfill value

maskvalue.description: Value searched for with has_mask option
maskvalue.title: Mask value
